why_half_was_chosen: Producer conservative partial-correction heuristic intended to avoid forcing uncertain illustrated pose. It was not a full-source residual objective or a justified acceptance rule; root explicitly rejected it as calibration completion.

source_left_right.limit: Linear interpolation only inside observed runs; omitted strap-crossing intervals are not reconstructed hard landmarks. Pose/illustration may explain asymmetry; do not symmetrize reference or refit by view.

actual_profile_pixel_check.meaning: Original row RGB check localizes ink/skin/background. Coarse width inputs lie in the declared4px width interval; values are not calibrated AP anatomy or a source camera recovery.

limits_not_yet_proven.cap_trap_scale: No full-source accumulated-silhouette solve attempted; homothety has not been proved insufficient.
limits_not_yet_proven.RX_RY_gate: Phi-prime lower bound is a limit of this selected profile gate, not an anatomical impossibility. Current shifts remain well within it.
limits_not_yet_proven.headcut: Original donor cutZ1.465 is mandatory. No proof that it blocks observed lower-neck intervals; a new neck collar must be designed and actually checked.
limits_not_yet_proven.fixed_components: Unchanged fan/wall/arm definitions can impose union competitor floors. Complete full-source feasibility has not been solved.
limits_not_yet_proven.pose: Trace2px is drawing read uncertainty, not a complete pose/camera interval. Frontyaw±4/profile±8/pitch±6deg must be propagated without refitting registration.

next_required_analysis: Form a bounded interval residual objective on TRUE accumulated silhouettes and visible neck sections. Separate provably conflicting fixed-domain observations from feasible residuals; propagate pose/camera uncertainty; solve few cap/trap/RX/RY parameters only after root approves. No amplitude grid/mesh/GPU.
